# Aerodynamics

Reports FAR's own aerodynamic state: angle of attack, sideslip, stall, lift and drag.

| --- | --- |
| Uplink id | `aero` |
| Version | `0.0.1` |
| Wraps | Ferram Aerospace Research 0.16.1.2 (ckan) |
